# 💩 Poople **The hilarious word ladder game — change one letter at a time to reach POOP.** [![Play Poople](https://img.shields.io/badge/Play-Poople%20Game-3d8b5e?style=for-the-badge)](https://poople-game.com/?ref=github) [![Poople Answer](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tool-Poople%20Answer-d97a2c?style=for-the-badge)](https://poople-game.com/poople-answer?ref=github) **[▶ Play Poople free](https://poople-game.com/?ref=github)** · no signup · works in any browser
--- ## What is Poople? **Poople** is a free online word ladder game (also known as a word-ladder puzzle, the format invented by Lewis Carroll in 1879). You start with a four-letter word and transform it into the target word **POOP** by changing **exactly one letter per step** — and every word in the chain must be a real, common English word. That is the whole game: simple rules, surprisingly deep gameplay. The **Poople game** is often described as a Wordle-style daily puzzle with a word-ladder twist: the target (POOP) is always visible, and your job is to find the shortest chain to it. > 👉 **[Play the Poople game now](https://poople-game.com/?ref=github)** — daily challenge + Poople unlimited mode, free forever. ## 🎮 Game modes | Mode | What it is | Link | |---|---|---| | **Poople Daily** | One shared puzzle every day, same start word for everyone, resets at midnight. Build a streak. | [Play today's Poople](https://poople-game.com/?ref=github_daily) | | **Poople Unlimited** | Endless fresh rounds from the curated puzzle pool. Practice any time. | [Poople Unlimited](https://poople-game.com/?ref=github_unlimited) | ## 🧩 Features - **Word ladder core** — BFS-verified shortest path under the hood, every puzzle is solvable. - **Daily + Poople unlimited** — one shared daily challenge plus endless practice rounds. - **Progressive hints** — up to 3 per puzzle: first letter → first+last → full word. - **Par & 3-star scoring** — solve in the expert par (or fewer) to earn 3 stars. - **Share your result** — one tap sends an emoji grid to X, WhatsApp, or your platform of choice. - **100% free, no signup** — runs entirely in your browser. ## 🛠 Poople tools (free) Stuck, or want to study the optimal path? These companion tools all run in the browser: - **[Poople Answer](https://poople-game.com/poople-answer?ref=github)** — enter any 4-letter word, get the shortest path to POOP revealed one step at a time. Today's poople answer is pre-loaded. - **[Poople Solver](https://poople-game.com/poople-solver?ref=github)** — BFS-powered word ladder solver for any word. - **[Poople Hints](https://poople-game.com/poople-hints?ref=github)** — step-by-step poople game hints whenever you are stuck. ## 📄 Pages | Page | Covers | |---|---| | [Poople home](https://poople-game.com/?ref=github) | poople, poople game | | [Poople Answer](https://poople-game.com/poople-answer?ref=github) | poople answer today | | [Poople Solver](https://poople-game.com/poople-solver?ref=github) | poople solver | | [Poople Hints](https://poople-game.com/poople-hints?ref=github) | poople hints, poople game hints | | [Word Ladder Game](https://poople-game.com/word-ladder-game?ref=github) | word ladder game, word ladder online | | [What Is Poople](https://poople-game.com/what-is-poople?ref=github) | what is poople | | [Four Letter Word Games](https://poople-game.com/four-letter-word-games?ref=github) | four letter word games, 4 letter words game | | [Poople Wordle](https://poople-game.com/poople-wordle?ref=github) | poople wordle | | [Poop Wordle](https://poople-game.com/poop-wordle?ref=github) | poop wordle | ## 🧲 Browser extension **[Poople Game Unlimited](https://poople-game.com/?ref=github_ext)** — a lightweight Chrome extension that pins the 💩 Poople game to your toolbar for one-click access to Poople daily, Poople unlimited, and the poople answer / poople solver tools. (See `chrome-extension/` for the source.) ## ⚙️ How the game works - Every puzzle starts with a four-letter English word. - Change **exactly one letter** per step. - Every intermediate word must be a valid common English word. - The target is always **POOP**. - **Par** = expert-set minimum steps. Solve at/under par for stars. - **Hints** = up to 3 per puzzle, progressive. For the full player walkthrough, see **[USER-GUIDE.md](./USER-GUIDE.md)**. ## 🧱 Tech stack Poople is built with **TanStack Start** (React 19, Vite, TypeScript), **Tailwind CSS 4**, **Paraglide JS** i18n (English + Chinese), and a self-contained BFS word-ladder engine — no external word API, the whole game runs client-side. ## 🗺 Roadmap - [ ] Daily puzzle playable inside the Chrome extension popup - [ ] Streak sync between site and extension - [ ] More word-ladder puzzle packs ## 🔗 Play The Poople game lives at **[poople-game.com](https://poople-game.com/?ref=github)** — open it and start reaching POOP. Daily poople puzzle, Poople unlimited practice, and the poople answer tool are all free. ## License Game content © Poople. Source in this repo is provided for reference.

## About [![View my project on File Exchange](https://www.mathworks.com/matlabcentral/images/matlab-file-exchange.svg)](https://www.mathworks.com/matlabcentral/fileexchange/180680) [![Open in MATLAB Online](https://www.mathworks.com/images/responsive/global/open-in-matlab-online.svg)](https://matlab.mathworks.com/open/fileexchange/v1?id=180680) `Colordle` is a color guessing game inspired by the popular NY Times game Worlde. There are several other games called "Colordle" that can be found online, but this version is a little different and can be played in Matlab. ## How to play With `Colordle` installed, type the following in the Matlab Command Window: ```matlab colordle ``` --- The main difference between `Colordle` and Wordle is that you need to guess a 6-character hexadecimal code instead of a 5-character word. The hexadecimal alphabet only has 16 characters, but unlike Wordle, every combination of characters is possible. Secondly, `Colordle` **does not color tiles in the same way as Wordle**. That is, a tile will not turn yellow if you guess a correct character in the wrong tile position. Instead, a tile will only turn yellow if your guess for that tile is within ±3 of the true character. If you guess a tile correctly, however, the tile will turn green--the same as Wordle. For a refresher on hexadecimal codes, I recommend the explanation by [Math is Fun](https://www.mathsisfun.com/hexadecimal-decimal-colors.html). ## Useful features * There are 2563=16,777,216 possible hexadecimal combinations. To keep the game fair, `Colordle` shows you the color that you are trying to guess. * `Colordle` tracks your stats after every game. To view your stats, click the middle button in the top-right corner (it looks like a graph). * Stats are stored in a file called `colordle_statistics.txt`, which is saved and updated automatically in the Desktop folder on your PC. * For macOS and UNIX users, `colordle_statistics.txt` should theoretically save in the `HOME` environment, but as a Windows user I cannot test this. However, I am confident that it will work for UNIX operating systems because I tested the Colordle app in MATLAB Online and it worked just fine. * Unlike Worlde, you can play as many games of `Colordle` per day as you want. Just click the button in the top right (it looks like a clockwise arrow) to begin a new game.

# Colordle

A colorful spin on the popular word guessing game. Made with React, Typescript, and Tailwind CSS.

### [Try it out!](https://colordle.lina.garden/)

## Build and run 

### To Run Locally:

Clone the repository and perform the following command line actions:

```bash
cd colordle
npm install
npm run start
```

### To build/run docker container:

#### Development

```bash
docker build -t game:dev .
docker run -d -p 3000:3000 game:dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in browser.

#### Production

```bash
docker build --target=prod -t game:prod .
docker run -d -p 80:80 game:prod
```

Open [http://localhost](http://localhost) in browser.

# Colordle

Daily Colordle game with an adjustable seed. https://colordle.org/

Guess the color by color names or hex codes. The percentage shows how close you are to the hidden color.

Color names are from https://github.com/meodai/color-names?tab=readme-ov-file
